newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ostgota Bank board recommends bid acceptance.
newsitem.headline: Ostgota Bank board recommends bid acceptance.

text.p: The board of Swedish bank Ostgota Enskilda Bank recommended on Friday shareholders to accept the bid from Danish bank Den Danske Bank.
The recommendation follows Swedish property and holding company Lundbergs selling its 76.9 percent stake in provincial bank Ostgota Enskilda Bank to Den Danske Bank for 50.50 crowns each on March 17.
Den Danske Bank also offered to acquire the rest of the shares in Ostgota Enskilda bank on the same conditions and on Tuesday it said it controlled 81.1 percent of the share capital and votes.
Ostgota Enskilda Bank is a provincial bank operating in southern Sweden with 550 staff and 29 branches.
